en: Black‑and‑white view of a rural Alpine valley with steep forested mountains in the background. A dirt path runs through dense vegetation toward a multi‑story white building on the right side, labeled as a mountain hotel. The caption strip at the bottom identifies the location as Bresimo in Val di Non at 1000 meters above sea level and mentions the Albergo Alpino with baths at La Rotonda, owned by Battista Dalla Torre.
